description: One record per submitted quantum algorithm. Every pipeline node appends its own proof; nothing is trusted without one.

algorithm.description: The submitted algorithm as OpenQASM 3 (or QASM 2) text.

algorithm_id.description: Client-supplied id, e.g. 'grover-3q-v1'. Used as the Google Sheets per-algorithm tab name.

completed_algorithm.description: The corrected/optimized algorithm as OpenQASM 3 text. Null until the transpiler runs.

proofs.description: One entry per pipeline node, in pipeline order. A node that cannot run records result 'skipped' instead of faking a proof.

certificate.description: Optional machine-checkable certificate (Compact build_certificate output, or a QCEC checker breakdown).

check.description: What this node proved, e.g. 'optimization', 'equivalence', 'per-pass validation', 'verified-optimization', 'simulation'.

duration_s.description: Wall time this node took, stamped by the runner.

result.description: 'pass'/'equivalent'/'verified' count as passing. 'out-of-scope' means the checker cannot cover this circuit (e.g. non-Clifford gates for transpile-verify) — honest, not a failure of the algorithm.

fidelity.description: Hellinger fidelity between the original and completed circuits' Aer simulation distributions (1024 shots). Null before the simulator runs.

gate_count.description: Gate count of the COMPLETED circuit.

overall.description: 0-1. Weighted: 0.30 simulation fidelity + 0.25 QCEC equivalence + 0.20 depth reduction + 0.10 gate reduction + 0.15 proofs-pass fraction.

score_breakdown.description: Optional: the five components that produced score.overall.

title: Quantum Algorithm Proof Record
